_readme: Move tutor compatibility for every Pokémon in pokedex.json (keys = Pokémon names in pokedex.json). 'list' = the moves of the four tutors (Special, Driftveil, Lentimas, Humilau) with their Pitch Black 2 type. 'tutor' = every tutor move it can learn in Pitch Black 2; 'new' = the ones it could NOT learn from a tutor in vanilla Black 2/White 2 (for Pokémon from later generations and variants: compared with their official compatibility). Unchanged Pokémon keep exactly their vanilla Black 2/White 2 tutor moves.
